topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, now, this is a mournful turn of the earth. Greta told me today she's leaving this village for some far-off place called the city. It's as if the crops know, they’re not as lively as they used to be. We’ve shared many a quiet moment, just the two of us, watching the sun dip below the hills, talking about the simplest things, like the feel of good soil or the scent after a rain. I told her what my Da always said, that roots run deep, even if the wind scatters the seeds. She nodded, a tear or two falling like the first drop of a light rain. I’ll miss her, but I’ll keep her in my prayers, and maybe, when the time is right, we’ll plant something together, even if it’s just in memory.
